description: Inspect autonomous payment proposals against structured policy, retrieve public signed OCD receipts, and check receipt proofs. Inspection is unsigned and performs no sanctions screening. Verification returns VALID, INVALID or UNVERIFIABLE; it does not establish payment safety, compliance or service delivery. This free plugin does not execute payments, hold funds or access private operations.

defaultPrompt: Inspect this proposed payment against my policy before I send it.
Retrieve this OnChainDiligence receipt and explain what happened.
Verify this OCD receipt and tell me what the proof does and doesn't establish.
